title: Document Index and Component Family Listings
topics: Table of Index - grinding wheel retrieval codes
Splined shaft and grinding groove on gear
Thread requirements for ring nuts on shafts
Shaft surface finish for oil dynamic film bearings

Component families: pinion shafts, solar shafts, spline shafts, hollow shafts, sliding coupling bars, planetary pins, ring gears, planetary gears, sun gears, shafts with bore, planet carriers, ring nuts
rules: Grinding wheel retrieval codes must follow standardized nomenclature (TAB 001)
Threaded tools require proper retrieval groove design (TAB 002)
Centering bodies must accommodate threaded holes per standards (TAB 003)
Oil seal seating on shaft ends and bores requires specific geometry (TAB 004)
Bearing seating surfaces must meet defined tolerances (TAB 005)
Circlip seating grooves have standardized dimensions (TAB 006)
Splined shafts require grinding grooves on gears (TAB 007)
Grinding wheel escape grooves must be provided (TAB 008)
Ring nut threads on shafts follow specific standards (TAB 009)
Shaft surface finish for oil dynamic film bearings must meet requirements (TAB 010)
Gear/pinion teeth execution follows modular standards (e.g. 20°) (TAB 011)
Drilling and spotfacing operations have defined conventions (TAB 013)
Shaft-blank disc connections require specific details (TAB 015)
ISO triangular profile threads must be properly specified (TAB 017)
Assembly and sectional views follow drafting conventions (TAB 098)
surface_finish: Shaft surface finish requirements for oil dynamic film bearings (TAB 010)
manufacturing_notes: Grinding wheel codes facilitate tooling retrieval
Threaded tool grooves aid in manufacturing operations
Gear teeth execution specified by module and pressure angle
Spline representation standards ensure manufacturing clarity
training_guidance: NX agent should reference TAB documents when designing shafts with bearing seats, seal seats, circlip grooves, or threaded features
When modeling gears and pinions, consult TAB 011 for tooth execution standards including module and pressure angle specifications
Spline features on shafts should follow involute spline representation standards per TAB 012
Keyway modeling must adhere to TAB 014 standards for proper fit and function
Surface finish for bearing seats and oil film bearing shafts requires special attention per TAB 005 and TAB 010
Component families 66300-series (shafts), 66311 (hollow shafts), 66410-66500 (gears) have specific design rules documented in respective sections
Assembly and mounting drawings should follow conventions in TAB 098 and TAB 099
summary: This index page from the Bonfiglioli Technical Quality Handbook (MTQ-001) catalogs the document structure, listing TAB sheets covering manufacturing standards for shafts, gears, bearings, seals, threads, splines, and keyways. It provides a comprehensive reference map to detailed technical specifications organized by component family codes (66300-66600 series). The page serves as a navigation tool to access specific design rules, manufacturing constraints, and drawing conventions for power transmission components.
